pages.title: Sweet Dessert Hole
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Sweet Dessert Hole puts you in control of a hole that gathers dessert toppings. Sweep across the base to collect chocolate, fruit, cream and other ingredients before time runs out. Spend earned coins on upgrades for the hole.

pages.title: Happy Bubbles
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Happy Bubbles Boom! asks you to shoot bubbles into groups of three or more matching colors. Clear the board with well-placed shots and use bombs, rockets or rainbow boosters when needed. Completing a board with fewer shots improves the result.

pages.title: Frog Knight
pages.creator: CHCStudio
pages.description: Frog Knight arms a frog with projectiles for clearing bubbles from each stage. Aim toward the next bubble and release to fire the sword, choosing a line that reaches the targets while accounting for spiky obstacles in the scene.

pages.title: Mahjong Stack
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Mahjong Stack presents piles of three-dimensional tiles that tumble into place. Select three identical tiles to clear them through the bottom tray, managing its limited spaces as you uncover new options. Tools can help when the arrangement becomes difficult.

pages.title: Lost Puppy Rescue and Care
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Lost Puppy Rescue and Care follows a puppy found alone in the rain. Clean the little dog, offer food and help it settle into safety. Each care activity continues the story as the puppy gradually becomes more comfortable with you.

pages.title: Single Line Puzzle Drawing
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Single Line Puzzle Drawing asks you to trace a complete shape in one continuous stroke. Plan a route that covers every line without lifting your finger or drawing over a section twice. The starting point can determine whether the path works.

pages.title: Cloak Master Shooter Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Cloak Master Shooter Run combines a running route with shooting challenges. Guide the cloaked hero through each scenario, avoid obstacles and use your shots to deal with the targets ahead as you work toward completing the course.

pages.title: Snow Rush 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Snow Rush 3D sends one or two sledders down a snow-covered course. Steer around snowmen and other obstacles, jump from ramps and try to extend your distance. A second player can join to compete along the winter track.

pages.title: TCG Card Clicker
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: TCG Card Clicker combines clicking for coins with collecting cards from packs. New cards increase passive income, helping fund more openings. Trade duplicate cards to expand the collection and keep building the earnings that support your next purchase.

pages.title: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Black Pink St.Patricks day Concert lets you prepare the group's members for a themed performance. Choose outfits, accessories and makeup for their stage looks, combining the available styles to suit the St. Patrick's Day concert.

pages.title: War State IO - Conquer Battles
pages.creator: TearForge Studios
pages.description: War State IO - Conquer Battles puts you in command of troops moving between bases. Drag an army toward the building you want to capture while defending the camps you control. Occupying every enemy building wins the battle.

pages.title: Black pink Black Friday Fever
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Black pink Black Friday Fever focuses on styling Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé and Lisa. Select outfits and accessories for each member, coordinating the pieces into individual looks inspired by the game's Black Friday fashion theme.

pages.title: Drive, Race, Crash
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drive, Race, Crash offers several ways to use its collection of cars. Race on tracks, enter demolition derbies, launch from ramps or explore the city. Collect stars during the activities to unlock additional vehicles in the garage.

pages.title: Baby Piano Children Song
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Baby Piano Children Song provides five musical instruments to experiment with. Choose the piano, xylophone, flute, drums or guitar and play its notes and sounds. Switching instruments gives you a different way to explore the game's music activities.

pages.title: Run 3D
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Run 3D takes its running course into space, where gaps and changing platforms threaten every step. Guide the character through the route, jumping and sliding to negotiate the obstacles while keeping clear of the surrounding void.

pages.title: Mech Monster Arena
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Mech Monster Arena turns robot combat into a contest of skill choices. Select abilities according to their counter rules during each turn-based battle. Earn experience and coins from fighting to develop your mech for the next opponents.

pages.title: Block Dropping Merge
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Block Dropping Merge lets you drop numbered blocks beside matching values to combine them into larger numbers. Check the next block before choosing a position, making room for further merges and trying to keep the board from filling.

pages.title: BlockPuzzle : Color Blast
pages.creator: Friendzy
pages.description: BlockPuzzle : Color Blast asks you to drag block shapes into the board and complete lines to remove them. Arrange the pieces around the gaps that remain, clearing the board's blocks to finish levels and earn a higher score.

pages.title: Mahjong Seasons 1 - Spring and Summer
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Mahjong Seasons 1 - Spring and Summer uses flowers, birds and other seasonal symbols on its tiles. Match identical pairs to remove them and expose the tiles beneath, planning your selections to clear the complete arrangement.

pages.title: My Halloween Park
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: My Halloween Park lets you run an amusement park built around spooky attractions. Gather ghosts for the haunted house so visitors can enter, then use the money it earns to unlock and improve more facilities around the park.

pages.title: Ultimate Stunt Car Challenge
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Ultimate Stunt Car Challenge sends cars over obstacle-filled stunt tracks. Drive forward or backward and adjust the vehicle's balance to handle the course. Try the challenges alone or compete with a second player in the game's two-player mode.

pages.title: Parkour Block 5
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Parkour Block 5 sends you through block-built platforming stages using movement, running and jumping. Judge the space between platforms and time each leap to continue along the course. A hardcore mode offers an additional challenge alongside the regular levels.

pages.title: Glass Puzzle
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Glass Puzzle challenges you to knock down water glasses by dropping balls onto the scene. Choose where to release each ball and consider what its impact will move. Different placements can produce different solutions to a level.

pages.title: Castle of Magic
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Castle of Magic follows a spell-wielding hero through five magical lands. Defeat monsters and use transformations to cross interactive surfaces, including areas that let you fly, float or walk on ceilings. The terrain changes how you approach each stage.

pages.title: Perfect Box
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Perfect Box challenges you to grow a box until it fits a gap between platforms. Hold to increase its size and release when the dimensions look right. An exact fit earns extra points, while an oversized or undersized box ends the run.

pages.title: Sniper killer
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Sniper killer gives you distant targets to eliminate with a sniper rifle. Aim carefully through each mission and make use of helpful props in the scene. A limited bullet allowance makes choosing a clean shot part of the challenge.

pages.title: Stick Warrior Hero Battle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stick Warrior Hero Battle sends armed ragdoll heroes into dangerous arenas. Choose from fighters with different weapons and abilities, then maneuver through the battles. Its single-player and two-player modes offer separate ways to tackle the stickman fights.

pages.title: Clock Puzzle for Kids
pages.creator: Smart Play Studios
pages.description: Clock Puzzle for Kids turns reading a clock into a points challenge. Look at the displayed clock and identify the time it shows. Use the positions of its hands to choose an answer and continue building your score.

pages.title: Hidden Animals
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hidden Animals hides creatures throughout forest scenes for you to locate. Search the picture closely and select each animal you find. Completing all the required discoveries lets you work through the game's eight levels.

pages.title: Opposites
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Opposites presents a choice activity about things with contrasting meanings. Look at the prompt and select the option that represents its opposite. Work through the examples by comparing the alternatives shown on the screen.

pages.title: Count Master 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Count Master 3D asks you to build a force capable of capturing castles. Drag the available formulas to add soldiers to your group and strengthen them with weapons. Increasing the army's size and attack power supports the next assault.

pages.title: Christmas Swap
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Christmas Swap fills its board with seasonal candy tiles. Drag a tile to form a match of three identical pieces and replenish the timer. Keep finding new matches to extend the round before the remaining time disappears.

pages.title: Mora Rush
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Mora Rush uses rock-paper-scissors hand signs as its central challenge. Follow the displayed prompts and change your hand gesture to make the winning choice. Pay attention to the next sign as you continue through the sequence.

pages.title: Pop Halloween
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Pop Halloween lets you clear groups of two or more matching Halloween items with a click. Look for larger clusters, since removing more items at once increases the points earned per item. Keep combining useful groups to improve your score.

pages.title: Boomerang Snipe 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Boomerang Snipe 3D challenges you to destroy a block-built pixel pattern with a thrown boomerang. Adjust the throw to reach the remaining pieces while avoiding stickman enemies. You can keep throwing until the provided pattern is cleared.

pages.title: Unicorns Jumper
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Unicorns Jumper sends its character upward with left and right jumps. Tap the corresponding half of the screen to choose a direction, aiming to reach greater heights. Higher progress unlocks additional characters for later attempts.

pages.title: Jump Monster
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Jump Monster asks you to steer a jumping character left and right through its course. Keep adjusting its position to continue upward and earn points, then use those points to unlock characters with different special abilities.

pages.title: Portal Billiards
pages.creator: Zen Kong
pages.description: Portal Billiards replaces ordinary pockets with colored portals on a space-themed table. Send red balls into red portals and blue balls into blue ones. The portals change position after shots, so each turn calls for a fresh look at the table.

pages.title: Top Speed Racing 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Top Speed Racing 3D combines driving events with stunt challenges and demanding obstacles. Complete events to earn money and put your car through different courses. Steering, braking and nitro help you handle the next stretch of the route.

pages.title: Rotated Cups
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Rotated Cups asks you to deliver a ball from its cup into the designated bucket. Drag to tilt the cups and control when the ball falls, lining up its route through the arrangement until it reaches the destination.

pages.title: Snowman 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Snowman 2020 Puzzle offers six snowman pictures to reconstruct as jigsaws. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces for an image, then move the sections into place to restore the complete winter scene.

pages.title: Making Words
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Making Words gives you letters to arrange into words. Consider the available characters and put them into a useful order to complete the activity. Each answer depends on selecting the letters that form the required word.

pages.title: Summer Ball 2020
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Summer Ball 2020 lets you prepare Clara and Eliza for a summer ball in London. Choose outfits and matching accessories for both princesses, then complete their makeup so each has a finished look for the event.

pages.title: Takeover
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Takeover places three nations in a struggle for the Rivadis Empire after necromancers seize power. Lead your chosen side in real-time strategy battles, directing its forces as you fight to take control of the continent.

pages.title: Family Shopping Mall
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Family Shopping Mall combines a shopping trip with outfit styling and fashion contests. Browse stores for clothes, shoes and accessories, assemble a look and take it onto the catwalk. Vote on other outfits as part of the style competitions.

pages.title: Race Cars Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Race Cars Puzzle 2 provides six race-car pictures with four jigsaw sizes each. Rebuild your chosen image from 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, fitting the vehicle and background sections together to finish the scene.

pages.title: Wrestling Fight
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Wrestling Fight turns a wrestling bout into a tapping challenge. Time your input to overcome the opponent in the fighting area, keeping the exchange going as you try to finish with a higher score than before.

pages.title: Police Car Chase Crime Racing Games
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Police Car Chase Crime Racing Games lets you patrol a large driving area in police vehicles. Explore city streets and surrounding countryside while pursuing drivers who have committed offenses. Control your car to catch them and make arrests.

pages.title: Sniper Shot 3D
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Sniper Shot 3D gives you stickman targets to eliminate with a sniper weapon. Move into position and line up your aim before firing, working through the targets quickly while keeping each shot directed at its mark.

pages.title: Big Monster Truck Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Big Monster Truck Jump makes the larger truck leap over a smaller one. Click the appropriate side of the screen to trigger its jump, judging the approach of the other vehicle so the trucks pass without colliding.

pages.title: Spartan And Viking Warriors Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Spartan And Viking Warriors Memory hides warrior pictures behind face-down tiles. Turn over two tiles at a time and remember their locations to find matching pairs. Clear all the pairs across four levels while trying to use fewer moves.

pages.title: 4 Colors Battle
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: 4 Colors Battle sends colored balls toward a rotating circle. Tap to turn the circle until the incoming ball meets the same color. A mismatch ends the attempt, so watch the next ball before choosing another rotation.

pages.title: Dunk Game
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Dunk Game lets one or two players compete on a basketball court. Move your player left or right and throw the ball toward the basket. Play alone or share the keyboard with a friend for a two-player match.

pages.title: Truck Coloring Book
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Truck Coloring Book contains eight truck pictures and a palette of twenty-three colors. Fill the images with your chosen shades, aiming to finish quickly for a better score. You can save the completed colored picture afterward.

pages.title: Punch Box
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Punch Box follows a boxer training against a stack of wooden boxes. Switch sides to punch the boxes away while avoiding their sharp protrusions. Keep breaking boxes before the timer runs out, without letting the wood knock you out.

pages.title: Fashion Girl Career Outfits
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Fashion Girl Career Outfits lets you dress a college graduate for different jobs. Choose clothing suited to careers such as nursing, teaching, performing or space travel, coordinating a fresh outfit for each role she wants to try.

pages.title: Animals Shapes
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Animals Shapes asks you to match animals with their corresponding silhouettes. Drag each animal onto the shape that fits its outline, comparing the body and features with the available spaces to complete the picture-matching activity.

pages.title: Classic Jeep Sim Parking 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Classic Jeep Sim Parking 2020 puts a jeep into a series of parking challenges. Steer the vehicle toward its parking position and line it up within the available space, using careful adjustments to complete the maneuver.

pages.title: Stickman Ninja Warriors
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Stickman Ninja Warriors follows a shuriken-throwing ninja on a rescue mission. Work out how to throw the weapon so that it breaks the cage holding the princess. Each scene turns the rescue into a targeting puzzle.

pages.title: BTS Muscle Car Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Muscle Car Coloring provides muscle-car drawings for you to color. Pick up the brush, select shades and apply them to the vehicle picture. Experiment with different combinations to give the car your own paint scheme.

pages.title: Christmas Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Christmas Cars Match 3 fills its board with holiday car tiles. Arrange at least three matching pieces in a row to score points and keep the side gauge from falling too low. Continue making matches to sustain the round.

pages.title: Cyber Truck Drive Simulator
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Cyber Truck Drive Simulator sends you across a map to collect flags in a pickup truck. Plan a route that reaches them while keeping vehicle damage down. Braking and selectable camera views help with positioning on the drive.

pages.title: Dr.Rocket
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Dr.Rocket lets you pilot a rocket through three space-themed modes. Guide its movement and work toward longer flights, advancing through ranks that unlock additional planetary settings. Launch-mode distance contributes to the progression from an astronaut toward higher pilot ranks.

pages.title: Lof Shadow Match 1
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Lof Shadow Match 1 shows an image beside several possible shadows. Choose the silhouette that matches the original picture's outline. Correct answers add five hundred points, while a wrong selection removes one hundred from your score.

pages.title: Water Power Boat Racer 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Water Power Boat Racer 3D takes its racing challenges onto the water with a motorized watercraft. Navigate the course and tackle the missions across ten levels, using the available room on the water to control each run.

pages.title: Marble Balls 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Marble Balls 3D challenges you to find a route by knocking marbles into one another. Consider how a collision will redirect the next ball, then make a move that carries the arrangement toward the level's solution.

pages.title: Sheep Sling
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Sheep Sling sends a sheep upward through a course of obstacles. Drag and release to sling it toward the next position, using bounces and swings to keep climbing. Gather coins to unlock other animals for later runs.

pages.title: Jelly Sea
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Jelly Sea challenges you to guide a colored jelly through matching sections of circular obstacles. Tap to jump and watch the jelly's current color before approaching the next ring, choosing a safe route through the moving arrangement.

pages.title: BasketBall
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: BasketBall focuses on throwing a basketball toward the hoop. Touch and drag to line up the ball's release, adjusting the shot as you try to get it into the basket. Play through the single-player shooting challenge.

pages.title: Tank Shootout
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Tank Shootout gives your tank a limited supply of bullets for clearing targets. Set each shot's direction and speed, using the power panel to judge the launch. Destroy every target before the level's ammunition runs out.

pages.title: Street Food Master Chef
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Street Food Master Chef lets you prepare food at a collection of street-food stalls. Work with dishes such as fries, hotdogs, pizza, burgers, noodles and churros, following the cooking activities to put together the selected snack.

pages.title: BTS Fish Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Fish Coloring Book offers fish pictures for creating your own underwater artwork. Select an outline and apply colors wherever you want them. Mix different shades across the fish to turn the drawing into a finished colored picture.

pages.title: Spinny Gun Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Spinny Gun Online challenges you to shoot targets with a spinning weapon. Hit targets and bosses to collect coins, then spend the earnings on additional guns. Time your shots to keep building the score through the shooting rounds.

pages.title: Candy Rush
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Candy Rush asks you to match at least three candies of the same type and reach a target score. Larger matching groups award more points, helping you clear the required total and advance to the next level.

pages.title: EG Two Cars
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Two Cars divides the road between a red car and a blue car under your control. Collect every circle in both lanes while avoiding square obstacles. Keep watching both vehicles, because a missed circle can spoil the attempt.

pages.title: King of Drift
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: King of Drift challenges you to keep driving for as long as possible. Guide the car through the route without sliding off course, working to extend the run and improve the distance you recorded on the previous attempt.

pages.title: Jewel Magic Xmas
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Magic Xmas dresses its matching puzzles in Christmas decorations. Make triplets to work through the level goals, considering each turn before choosing a match. A daily wheel offers boosters that can help with more difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Galaxy Defense
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Galaxy Defense places a cannon beneath a field of alien debris represented by bubbles. Aim upward and shoot to clear the arrangement, using matching groups and dropped clusters to remove more of the field.

pages.title: Pool Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pool Party puts you alongside a party planner choosing between two venues. Decorate each poolside location for the girls' weekend celebration, comparing how the finished spaces look before deciding where the party should take place.

pages.title: Princess phone Decoration
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess phone Decoration lets you help Elsa give her smartphone a football-themed appearance. Choose decorative details inspired by the 2018 World Cup and arrange a finished design that suits the phone and its owner.

pages.title: Guns and Blocks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Guns and Blocks puts a firing starship below a field of blocks. Move the ship to break as many blocks as possible, collecting points to buy power-ups. Upgrade firing speed and power to handle more of the field.

pages.title: Princess In Prom Night
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess In Prom Night lets you style Ariel, Rapunzel and Moana for their prom. Choose outfits and accessories for each princess, combining the wardrobe pieces into three finished looks for the evening event.

pages.title: Happy Dessert
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Happy Dessert puts you in charge of a dessert canteen. Hire a chef, research recipes and prepare the ingredients required for your menu. Building up the kitchen's staff and recipes gives you more to manage as the business develops.

pages.title: Air Hockey Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Air Hockey Game lets you challenge a computer opponent at a selected difficulty. Move the paddle to send the puck toward the other goal while defending your own. The first side to score fifteen points wins the match.

pages.title: Sea Bubble Pirates 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sea Bubble Pirates 2 takes bubble shooting aboard a pirate ship. Aim the cannon at matching colors to pop groups of bubbles and collect golden coins as rewards. Look for useful shots through each bubble-filled arrangement.

pages.title: Sweet Astronomy: Cookie Adventure
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sweet Astronomy: Cookie Adventure takes candy matching into a space-themed puzzle journey. Swipe pieces into useful combinations and work toward the displayed level goals, keeping track of the available moves or time as the challenge changes.

pages.title: Princess Trendy Shopaholic
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Trendy Shopaholic follows a princess around a shopping center to assemble a new look. Start with clothing, then visit the bag and shoe shop to coordinate accessories. Choose pieces that work together as a complete outfit.

pages.title: Sweet Princess Dressing Room!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sweet Princess Dressing Room! lets you design a dressing room for a princess. Arrange clothing and shoes into a coordinated space, choosing combinations that shape the room's appearance and display the wardrobe the way you prefer.
